extName.message: Imgkeep — Save image as PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or PDF
extName.description: Store name and extension name. Max 75 characters. Keep 'Imgkeep' and the format names.

extDescription.message: Right-click to save any image as PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or PDF. Converts WebP and AVIF on your device, into your folder. No tracking.

menuGif.description: Menu item: save as GIF, keeping animation.

menuOriginal.description: Menu item: save the file unchanged.

askErrBlocked.message: The site didn't hand over this image, even with access allowed. The server may be down, or it only serves the image inside its own pages.

askErrHttp.message: The site answered with an error instead of the image.

askErrDecode.message: Your browser couldn't read this file as an image.

askErrUnsupported.message: This browser version can't create this format. Try PNG instead.

askErrBlob.message: This image only exists inside the page (a blob: link). Imgkeep can't read it because it has no access to your pages.

askErrTooLarge.message: This image is too large to convert in the browser.

askErrTimeout.message: Converting this image took too long, so Imgkeep stopped. Try PNG, or a shorter or smaller animation.

askErrDownload.message: Your browser couldn't start the download.

askErrWrite.message: Imgkeep couldn't write the file to your folder.

askErrExpired.message: This save has expired. Right-click the image and try again.

askErrUnknown.message: Something went wrong while saving this image.

detailGifPixels.message: $W$×$H$ pixels × $COUNT$ frames is more than a GIF can hold here.

detailTooManyFiles.message: Too many files with this name.

askSavedTo.description: Status after saving into a folder.

askHostBody.message: $HOST$ blocks other sites from reading its images, so Imgkeep can't convert this one yet.

askHostNote.message: Access is for this one site only, to fetch images you pick. You can remove it any time in Options.

askNotAllowed.message: Access wasn't allowed. Nothing was saved.

askReconnectTitle.description: Window title. Use your language's quotation marks.

askReconnectBody.message: Your browser needs your OK to save into this folder again.

askChooseBody.message: Pick the folder where Imgkeep should save your images.

askEveryVisit.message: When your browser asks, choose $OPTION$ so it won't ask again.

askEveryVisitOption.description: The browser's permission option that lasts. Describe it if the exact wording in your language is unknown.

askFolderDenied.message: Your browser didn't allow access to the folder. Nothing was saved.

askNoFolder.message: No folder chosen. Nothing was saved.

optPageTitle.description: Browser tab title of the options page

optSaved.description: Brief confirmation after a setting changes

optSaveMode.description: Hidden label for the three choices

optModeDownloadsHint.message: Saves to your browser's download folder. No questions asked.

optModeFolderHint.message: Writes straight into your folder. Your browser may ask you to reconnect after a restart.

optModeAskHint.message: Shows the browser's Save As dialog for each image.

optSubfolderHint.message: Optional. Use / for nested folders. Same tokens as file names.

optTokensHint.message: Tokens: {name} original name, {host} site, {date}, {time}, {w} and {h} size in pixels. Existing files are never overwritten.

optPreviewLabel.message: Preview for summer-banner from shop.example.com, 1600×900, as PNG:

optJpgBackgroundHint.message: JPG has no transparency, so see-through areas get this colour.

optSitesEmpty.message: None yet. Imgkeep asks only when a site blocks an image you want to convert.

optRemoveAccess.description: Accessible label for the Remove button

optProBody.message: Rules: send each site's images to the right folder, in the right format, with the right name, without choosing every time. Plus a log of where every image came from.

optProFree.message: Everything you use today stays free.

optTrustTitle.message: What Imgkeep can and can't do

optTrust1.message: Images are converted on your computer. Nothing is uploaded; there's no analytics.

optTrust2.message: No ads, no review requests, no welcome tabs. A small window opens only when a save needs your OK.
